claim: For EVERY n including zero, the full original H0(n) is genuinely complex-linearly equivalent to global sections of the actual degree-one algebraic line to its nth tensor power, over the ORIGINAL structural complex scalars. The SAME algebraic line has a nonzero original theta section and full H0 dimension one.

obligations.name: Full original input
obligations.required_input: A theta-span statement would not compare arbitrary sections.
obligations.constructed_input: Pad arbitrary original H0(n) sections using their recovered entire representatives and exact original multiplier.
obligations.justification: Pad arbitrary original H0(n) sections using their recovered entire representatives and exact original multiplier.

obligations.name: Actual regular coefficient
obligations.required_input: Analytic quotients alone do not define algebraic sections.
obligations.constructed_input: Use whole H0(3n) cubic regularization; the padding already makes the literal degree-one coefficient regular with no analytic division.
obligations.justification: Use whole H0(3n) cubic regularization; the padding already makes the literal degree-one coefficient regular with no analytic division.

obligations.name: Full degree-one cocycle
obligations.required_input: Power labels alone do not identify the original line.
obligations.constructed_input: Use exact extracted tensor-power frames of SAME L and full regular function separation on every overlap.
obligations.justification: Use exact extracted tensor-power frames of SAME L and full regular function separation on every overlap.

obligations.name: Genuine gluing
obligations.required_input: Compatible closed-point values are not global sheaf sections.
obligations.constructed_input: Apply actual module-sheaf gluing on all-prime mixed cover with every-subopen section action.
obligations.justification: Apply actual module-sheaf gluing on all-prime mixed cover with every-subopen section action.

obligations.name: Reverse holomorphy
obligations.required_input: Arbitrary algebraic sections cannot be assumed holomorphic.
obligations.constructed_input: Extract genuine regular coefficients, apply actual arbitrary-open holomorphy, then glue through the independently produced degree-one gauge.
obligations.justification: Extract genuine regular coefficients, apply actual arbitrary-open holomorphy, then glue through the independently produced degree-one gauge.

obligations.name: Exact original automorphy
obligations.required_input: A hidden flat twist would invalidate the comparison.
obligations.constructed_input: Retain full original lattice factor before original section descent, including degree zero.
obligations.justification: Retain full original lattice factor before original section descent, including degree zero.

obligations.name: Both inverse laws
obligations.required_input: Forward injection is not whole-section equivalence.
obligations.constructed_input: Prove whole regular coefficient recovery by reduced function separation and both inverse maps by sheaf uniqueness and nonzero original gauges.
obligations.justification: Prove whole regular coefficient recovery by reduced function separation and both inverse maps by sheaf uniqueness and nonzero original gauges.

obligations.name: Actual complex scalars
obligations.required_input: Transporting complex action along the equivalence would be circular.
obligations.constructed_input: Use literal structural base map and full GammaSpec/open scalar square to prove complex linearity and actual positive-degree dimension n squared.
obligations.justification: Use literal structural base map and full GammaSpec/open scalar square to prove complex linearity and actual positive-degree dimension n squared.

obligations.name: Original theta and limits
obligations.required_input: A formal first power or basis count is not the original theta section or a smooth divisor.
obligations.constructed_input: Use actual tensor-unit sheaf isomorphism, original theta independence and full section comparison to produce nonzero theta spanning H0(L); divisor and dual/Jacobian geometry remain separate.
obligations.justification: Use actual tensor-unit sheaf isomorphism, original theta independence and full section comparison to produce nonzero theta spanning H0(L); divisor and dual/Jacobian geometry remain separate.
